input.title: BH | Premier Bray Medium Walnut Star Jupe Dining Table — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
In Bray the best meals are never rushed, whether at one of the village's famous tables or at home near the river, where a lunch for four has a way of becoming a lunch for six. This dining table is made to allow for that. Closed, it is a 55-inch round sized for a smaller dining room or a kitchen; opened, it grows to 70 inches, and its leaves wait inside the table until they are needed.

Solid walnut is trimmed with white oak veneer, and an inlaid star radiates from the centre of the top, spreading as the leaves go in. The single pedestal base takes its lines from timber frame building, leaving the whole edge free for chairs, and the top parts on an aluminum mechanism that opens with ease. It comes in two boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a breakfast room or the dining end of an open kitchen, under a pendant light, with a jug of flowers in the middle and room to open it out when friends stay on. This listing is for one medium dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier West Village Twin Pedestal Jupe Dining Table
input.descriptionHtml:
Dinner in a West Village townhouse tends to start small and grow: a few friends invited, a few more told to drop by, and suddenly the table has to make room for a dozen. This table is made for that kind of night. It opens in both length and width, from 79 inches to 100 by 56, seats up to twelve when fully opened, and keeps its extra leaves stored inside the table itself, so there is never a hunt for them in the closet.

The top is wood veneer, walnut or ash according to the finish, and its leaves open out on an aluminum mechanism that moves with very little effort. It stands on two pedestals that taper and then flare at the foot, each finished with a metal band where it meets the floor, so no corner legs get in the way. It ships in two boxes and needs assembly.

Place it in a dining room under a long chandelier, set for a birthday dinner with every chair filled, the candles lit and the platters going around. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Gigondas Oval Pine Plank Dining Table
input.descriptionHtml:
In Gigondas, under the jagged limestone peaks of the Dentelles de Montmirail, harvest lunch is laid out on a long table between the vines and the house, with bread, cheese, something slow-cooked and the year's wine poured for everyone who picked. This dining table is made for that gathering. At more than seven feet long its oval top has room for a whole crew of family and friends, and its rounded ends mean nobody sits at a hard corner.

Its top is made from boards of old pine laid side by side as planks, and a carved apron, the rail beneath the top, runs around it, all raised on four shaped legs. Old pine carries the marks and mellow grain of its earlier life, so the table looks settled in from the first meal. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it in a dining room or a big country kitchen under a long pendant, dressed with a linen runner, earthenware platters and bottles down the middle, or bring it into a sunroom for long weekend lunches. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Stilton Large Jupe Dining Table — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
The cheese takes its name from Stilton, the village on the Great North Road where coaching travellers first bought it in the 1700s, and in England it still belongs to the end of dinner: a wedge on a board, a glass of port, and the table lingering long after the plates are cleared. This table is made for those slow last courses. It opens from 66 inches across to 85.5, so another friend or two can stay on for the port, and its leaves wait inside the table until they are needed.

It is acacia wood in a walnut-toned finish, and its top is laid in a patterned, farmhouse style. Underneath, four turned uprights rise from a trestle-style base, the braced frame of an old farmhouse table. The top draws apart on an aluminum mechanism that opens smoothly and easily. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Keep it in a dining room with a sideboard close by for the port and the cheese board, and open it out on the night two more chairs need a place, with candles low on the table and a bowl of grapes going around at the end. This listing is for one large dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Padstow Medium Oak and Iron Jupe Dining Table
input.descriptionHtml:
After a day on the Camel estuary, supper in a Padstow cottage is a small and easy thing: a pot of mussels in the middle, bread to mop up the broth, and everyone reaching in with a spoon. This table is made for that close kind of meal. At 55 inches across it keeps the pot within everyone's reach, and when the neighbours wander over its leaves come out from inside to open it to 71 inches.

It is built of oak and textured iron, with a clean geometric base bound by bands of metal worked by hand, which add strength where the frame joins. An aluminum mechanism lets the top slide open smoothly, and the leaves tuck away inside the table again afterward. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Put it in a kitchen corner by the window or a dining room, set with a big pot, a stack of bowls, a dish of lemon wedges and a jug of water, ready to open out when more friends arrive. This listing is for one medium dining table.

input.descriptionHtml:
In Whitstable, on the north Kent coast, an oyster lunch is rarely a small affair: a platter in the middle, friends wandering up from the harbour, and more chairs pulled in as the afternoon goes on. This round table is made for that open-ended kind of meal. It starts as a generous round for the regular crowd, then its top parts and opens to more than seven feet across, with leaves that wait inside the table until the doorbell keeps ringing.

The top is oak, and the table stands on a simple geometric base that keeps its outline clean whether it is open or closed. The leaves are stored within the table itself, and the extension glides open on an extruded aluminum mechanism. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Stand it in a dining room or a big kitchen under a low pendant, with a pot of mussels in the middle, bread and lemons within reach and a bucket of ice for the wine. This listing is for one large dining table.

This round table is made for that kind of Sunday. Closed, it fits a modest dining room or a kitchen corner, and when the doorbell rings again it opens to seat six, so nobody ends up eating from their lap.

It is a Jupe table, a round extending design whose top divides and opens around leaves set into the gaps. The leaves are self-storing, kept inside the table on an aluminum mechanism that opens with an easy pull. The top is wood veneer, and it stands on a base of four slim posts joined at the foot, finished with metal accents. It is delivered in two boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a dining room under a pendant, or in a kitchen corner by the window, with a bowl of fruit in the middle on weeknights and every leaf in for Sunday. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Haro Round Pedestal Dining Table — In Almond
input.descriptionHtml:
In the station quarter of Haro, Rioja's old bodegas stand side by side, and a visit there turns into a long Spanish lunch, with bottles opened, plates shared and nobody watching the clock. This round dining table is made for a lunch like that. With no corners and a single pedestal at its centre, everyone sits the same distance from the middle, close enough to reach the bread and pass the wine, with no table leg in anyone's way.

It is made of mango wood, lightly distressed to show off the grain and finished in a hard-wearing lacquer that stands up to years of meals. At 54 inches across it suits a family dinner or a lunch with friends. It arrives in three boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a dining room or a big kitchen under a pendant light, laid with a cloth, a jug of wine, bread and a platter of ham and cheese in the centre. This listing is for one dining table.

Mougins, the hill village above Cannes where Picasso spent his last years, is known for its tables: lunch in the shade of a little square, a plate of something simple and very good, and coffee that stretches well past three. This round dining table is made for that kind of lunch for a few. At 40 inches across it brings a small party close enough to share every dish, and its white marble top stays cool through a warm afternoon.

The top is white marble quarried in Rajasthan, in India, and it rests on a metal base in a dark finish that lets the stone take the light. At 31 inches tall it sits at a comfortable dining height, and its weight keeps it steady on a stone or wood floor. It ships in two boxes.

Set it in a breakfast room, a kitchen corner or by a window in an apartment, with a bowl of peaches, a carafe of wine and chairs pulled close. This listing is for one dining table.

Richard Neutra built his modernist houses around the Silver Lake reservoir for an open, easy way of living, where dinner moves between the kitchen and a table set against a wall of glass. This table is made for that relaxed modern supper. Its round top draws everyone to the middle, its single pedestal leaves room for chairs all the way around, and when the evening grows it opens from 66 inches to a full seven feet across.

The top is paldao veneer, a tropical hardwood with a bold, striped figure, and a band of stainless steel trim catches the light along the wood. The leaves store inside the table, and the extension runs on an extruded aluminum mechanism built for a smooth, quiet opening. It comes in two boxes and needs assembly.

Place it in an open-plan dining space under a sculptural pendant, with a bowl of salad, a bottle of wine and room for whoever stays, plus a pair of tall candles to catch the steel trim. This listing is for one large dining table.

It runs a full seven feet, with room for plenty of plates and platters, and its turned legs and weathered reclaimed pine bring a little of that coast's easy, salt-worn feel indoors.

Give it a dining room with a view or a long kitchen, set with candles in jars, a big salad bowl, a board of sourdough and a bottle of California red, with a bench or a row of mismatched chairs pulled up along each side. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Ferrara Carved Pedestal Dining Table — In Driftwood
input.descriptionHtml:
At the Este court in Ferrara, banquets were planned like theatre, and the duke's steward Cristoforo da Messisbugo set down course after course in a book of banquets published in 1549. This round table is made for a smaller feast in the same spirit, where every dish is passed by hand and every guest can see the others. Its carved pedestal rises like a tall urn from a broad base, so knees and chairs never meet a corner leg.

It is solid old reclaimed pine, carved richly through the pedestal and base, and the 40-inch top is finished with an ogee edge, a moulding that curves in an elegant S. The reclaimed timber brings depth and age to the carving, so it feels like a table with a past. It arrives in two boxes.

Set it in a small dining room or a kitchen bay under a low pendant, laid with a cloth, a bowl of figs, a loaf of bread and candles for supper. This listing is for one dining table.

When a big family sits down in the English countryside for a celebration, the meal runs its full course, from the roast through dessert to the wheel of Stilton and the port that closes it, and nobody wants the table to end. This table is made for those long gatherings. It is already 80 inches across when closed, and with its stored leaves in place it opens to a full 100 inches, a round big enough to bring the whole extended family together.

It is acacia wood in a walnut-toned finish, with a top laid in a patterned farmhouse style, carried on four turned uprights above a trestle-style base, the braced frame of a country table built to last. The leaves live inside the table and come out on an aluminum mechanism that opens with an easy pull. At 423 lbs it is a serious piece, and it arrives in two boxes and needs assembly by two or more people.

Make it the centre of a large dining room or a long great room for birthdays and holidays, with candles down the middle and the cheese board waiting on the sideboard. This listing is for one extra large dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Saint-Rémy Round Pedestal Dining Table — In Almond
input.descriptionHtml:
In Saint-Rémy lunch is the meal that matters: it starts late, runs long and moves from the market to a round table in the shade, with bread, olives and a cold rosé. This table brings that kind of lunch inside. Its round top means no one is stuck at the end and everyone can reach the bread, and because it stands on a single pedestal there is room for legs and chairs all the way around.

It is made of mango wood. The base rises as a column carved with arches, a form borrowed from old European buildings, and a band of dentil moulding, a row of small square blocks like teeth, runs around the apron, the rail beneath the top. At 54 inches across it is a generous size for a family table. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a breakfast room or the middle of a kitchen under a pendant light, with a jug of flowers, a basket of bread and a bottle of wine waiting for whoever comes to lunch. This listing is for one dining table.

input.descriptionHtml:
Montepulciano is a town of long tables. In its trattorias and family dining rooms, Sunday lunch runs from the first plate of salumi through a bottle or two of Vino Nobile and well into the afternoon, with cousins and neighbours added as they arrive. This dining table is built for that kind of meal. At more than nine feet long it gives everyone elbow room, and its turned legs set all that length on a shapely, traditional footing that suits a big family table.

The table is mango wood, a hardwood with a warm, lively grain that runs the full length of the top. Its 40-inch depth leaves a wide band down the middle for platters, bread boards and bottles while keeping conversation easy across the table. It arrives in one box and needs assembly.

Lay it with linen, candles and big serving dishes under a pair of pendants in a long dining room, or set it in a big kitchen where the cooking and the eating share one room. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Silver Lake Medium Paldao Jupe Dining Table — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
In the hillside houses of Silver Lake, where Richard Neutra designed modernist homes above the reservoir, a meal is rarely formal: a few friends, food straight from the stove, and a table never far from the view. This medium table is made for that easy kind of supper. At 55 inches round it fits a smaller dining space or the end of an open kitchen, and when friends stay on it opens to 70 inches, its leaves kept inside rather than in a closet.

Its top is veneered in paldao, a hardwood from Southeast Asia with a strongly striped grain, edged in a line of stainless steel that keeps the look crisp. One pedestal carries the top, leaving the corners free for chairs and knees, and the extension runs on an extruded aluminum mechanism that opens with an even pull. It needs assembly and arrives in two boxes.

Set it near a window in a condo or a small house, with a low bowl of lemons in the centre and a pair of candles, ready for a supper for two that turns into dinner for a crowd. This listing is for one medium dining table.

input.descriptionHtml:
Monsaraz sits on a hilltop inside its old walls above the Alentejo plain, and lunch there is unhurried: bread, olives, grilled fish and a jug of local wine, with nobody watching the clock. This dining table is made for small, slow meals like that. At 63 inches long it is sized for a close group around one table, near enough to share every dish.

It is acacia, a dense, durable hardwood, finished to look softened by sun and years of use. At 37 inches across it leaves room for a place at each end as well as along both sides, with a run down the middle for shared dishes. Its size also makes it a generous writing desk under a window. It ships in two boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a small dining room or a kitchen alcove under a pendant, with a jug of olive branches, a basket of bread and a bottle open for lunch, then clear it in the afternoon for letters and a laptop. This listing is for one dining table.

At nearly eight feet long it gives everyone room to work at their lobster without bumping elbows, and because it stands on two carved pedestals rather than four corner legs, chairs fit in all along the sides.

It is made of mango wood, a dense hardwood with a lively grain, and the two pedestals are carved in a traditional style that gives the table real presence from every side of the room. At 278 lbs it is a solid, settled piece that anchors a large dining room. It arrives in three boxes and needs assembly.

Make it the centrepiece of a dining room or a big kitchen, with a long bench down one side, chairs at the ends and a row of lanterns or candles down the centre for when the sun finally goes down. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Healdsburg Double Pedestal Dining Table — In Cocoa
input.descriptionHtml:
In Healdsburg the best dinners are the long ones, with friends from the next valley, a few bottles from down the road and plates passed until well after dark. This dining table is made for those evenings. At eight feet long it gives everyone room to spread out, and because it stands on two pedestals rather than four corner legs, chairs can go wherever they fit without anyone ending up astride a leg.

It is made of mango wood in a deep, warm finish, and its pedestals take their shape from classical architecture, giving the long top a solid, grounded stance. At 42 inches wide there is room down the middle for platters and candles as well as a full place setting on each side. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Place it in the middle of a dining room or a big kitchen under a pair of pendants, set with linen, candlesticks and the serving dishes down the centre, ready for a harvest supper or an ordinary Sunday lunch. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Chiswick Large Jupe Dining Table — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
The dining rooms of Georgian Chiswick were made for the long dinner party: candles lit early, the table extended for every friend in town, and conversation carrying on long after the last course. This large round table is made for those nights. A Jupe table opens in the round, its top parting so leaves can fill the gaps, and this one grows from a generous 66 inches across to more than seven feet, so a bigger party can gather without anyone losing sight of the rest.

At 333 lbs it stands firm and steady while the leaves go in, and once they are in there is room down the middle for platters, bread and the serving dishes, with every chair still facing the centre. It arrives in two boxes and needs assembly.

Centre it in a large dining room under a chandelier, with a long linen runner, tall candles and the roast carved at the table, and every chair in the house drawn up around it. This listing is for one large dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Montepulciano Square Mango Wood Dining Table — In Almond
input.descriptionHtml:
Not every meal in Montepulciano is a feast. Just as often it is a few people at a small table, a plate of pici, the thick hand-rolled pasta of southern Tuscany, and a glass of the local red, with the talk lasting far longer than the food. This square dining table is made for those close suppers. Everyone sits the same distance from everyone else, nobody is stranded at the end, and its turned legs give a compact table the presence of a much larger one.

It is made from mango wood, with a grain that shifts in tone across the top and gives each table its own character. At 40 inches square it fits neatly into a kitchen corner, a bay window or a small dining room where a long table would crowd. It arrives in one flat box and needs assembly.

Set it in an apartment dining area or a breakfast nook with a pendant hung low above it, a bowl of fruit at the centre and two candles for supper. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Castle Combe Reclaimed Pine Dining Table — In Cocoa
input.descriptionHtml:
Sunday lunch in a stone cottage at Castle Combe means a long table, a roast carved at one end, and the afternoon going by in conversation until someone puts the kettle on. This dining table is made for that kind of lunch. Its solid plank top is long enough for a full family gathering, and its turned legs give it the easy, lived-in look of an old farmhouse table.

It is made of reclaimed pine, timber that has already had one life, so the grain carries the knots and marks of its age. At 35 inches across there is room for a platter or two down the middle as well as a place setting on each side, and at nearly seven feet long it gives everyone generous elbow room. It arrives in one box and needs assembly.

Set it in the middle of a dining room or a big kitchen, with a bench along one side and chairs opposite, a jug of flowers in the centre and the roast on a board. On weekdays it makes a wide, easy surface for homework, the newspaper and the week's shopping list. This listing is for one dining table.

input.descriptionHtml:
John Constable was born in East Bergholt in 1776 and painted the Suffolk country around it again and again, a world of mills, farmhouses and big families gathered at one long table when the day's work was done. This dining table is made for that gathering. At seven feet long it takes a whole family with room to spare, and its big turned legs give it a solid, settled presence at the heart of the room.

It is oak, with a top of boards joined together and edges carved in an ogee, a gentle S-shaped curve. The legs are turned on a lathe and generously thick, which gives the table its sturdy farmhouse character. It arrives in one box and needs assembly.

Put it in the middle of a dining room or a large kitchen, with a bench down one side, chairs at the ends, a jug of wildflowers and the Sunday roast going around, and a stack of cookbooks at the far end between meals. This listing is for one dining table.

Set it in a kitchen nook with two chairs and a jug of flowers, or in a sunroom with a lamp, the morning paper and a pot of coffee for two. This listing is for one bistro table.

input.title: BH | Premier Bagatelle Medium Round Jupe Dining Table
input.descriptionHtml:
At Bagatelle, in the Bois de Boulogne, a June lunch among the roses has a way of growing: a friend spots another friend, chairs are pulled over, and the table somehow makes room. This round table is made for lunches like that. It opens from 55 inches across to 70, the way a Jupe table does, with its leaves stored inside the table itself, so there is always room for one more.

The top is ash over an oak core, and it rests on a reeded pedestal, a column cut with fine raised ribs, finished by hand in the old French craft of painting a surface to look like natural wood grain. With one central pedestal there are no legs in the way of anyone's knees, and the top opens on a smooth aluminum mechanism. It ships in two boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a breakfast room or a smaller dining room beneath a hanging lamp, closed for an everyday supper and opened out when friends stay on, with a jug of roses at its centre. This listing is for one medium dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Bagatelle Large Round Jupe Dining Table
input.descriptionHtml:
The rose beds at Bagatelle draw Parisians out to the Bois de Boulogne all summer, and the best of those days end around a big table at home, with family and friends lingering long after lunch. This large round table is made for those gatherings. It opens from 66 inches across to 84, with its leaves kept inside the table, so a table for an ordinary Sunday becomes one for the whole family in a moment.

Its top is ash laid over an oak core, and it stands on a single reeded pedestal, a column cut with fine raised ribs, finished by hand with a painted technique that gives it the look of natural wood grain. An aluminum mechanism lets the top open with an easy, even movement, and with no corner legs the chairs can go anywhere around it. It ships in two boxes and needs assembly.

Let it hold the centre of a large dining room or a long kitchen, with a linen cloth, a low bowl of roses and the platters passed from hand to hand. This listing is for one large round dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Carrara Marble Dining Table — In Jet with White Marble Top
input.descriptionHtml:
Around Carrara, where the mountains have been cut for marble since Roman times, Sunday lunch is a long affair: several courses, a few generations, and nobody rising before the coffee. This dining table is made for that kind of gathering. Its marble top stretches nearly seven feet, wide enough for platters down the middle and elbow room at every place, and its forged iron base carries all that stone with quiet strength.

The top is white marble with a gently distressed finish, so it reads as stone that has already seen years of family meals, and the base is iron wrought by hand in a dark, rustic finish. Together they weigh 436 lbs, a table that will not shift when the whole family leans in. It comes in two boxes and needs assembly, so plan for several people on delivery day.

Give it the centre of a dining room or a long kitchen, under a pair of pendants, with linen napkins, a big bowl of pasta and bottles of wine passed from hand to hand. This listing is for one dining table.

Set it in a kitchen corner, a breakfast nook or by a sunny window, with a bowl of fruit in the middle and chairs drawn close for coffee, or let it serve as the dining table in an apartment. This listing is for one breakfast table.

input.descriptionHtml:
In Cefalù, the Sicilian seaside town beneath its great rock and Norman cathedral, lunch means whatever came off the boats that morning, grilled simply and shared from the middle of the table. This round dining table is made for that kind of sharing. At 54 inches across there is room for a platter of fish at the centre that every guest can reach, with no corners to sit at and nobody left out at the end.

It is made of mango wood, a hardwood with a warm, lively grain, in a rich finish that brings out the figure of the wood. It stands at standard dining height, so the chairs you already have will pull straight up to it. It comes in two boxes and needs assembly.

Put it at the heart of a kitchen or a small dining room, with a bowl of lemons, a jug of water and a basket of bread, or set it in a sunroom for long weekend lunches. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Lecce Trestle Dining Table
input.descriptionHtml:
In Lecce, the honey-coloured Baroque city in the heel of Italy, Sunday lunch is a long affair: the whole family around one table, bowls of orecchiette passed hand to hand, and talk that runs on until the light turns gold on the carved stone outside. This trestle table is made for that table full of family. At seven feet long it brings everyone together, and its trestle base, two sturdy end supports in place of corner legs, leaves the long sides free for chairs and knees.

It is built of wood, solid and plain in the way of a farmhouse table, with a broad top 41 inches deep, enough for platters and bread boards down the middle and place settings on both sides. It ships in two boxes and needs assembly.

Let it fill a long dining room or a farmhouse kitchen, with a linen runner, a row of candles and a jug of wine, and pull a bench along one side for the children. This listing is for one dining table.

This dining table is made for that kind of meal. Closed, it seats the household on an ordinary night, and with its two 16-inch leaves in place it stretches past nine feet, long enough for everyone at a holiday table.

It is oak, with a thick top resting on a heavy base, and its lines are kept straight and plain so nothing distracts from the food and the company. The two leaves go in when guests arrive and come out again when the house is quiet. It ships in two boxes and needs assembly.

Put it down the long middle of a dining room or an open kitchen under a row of pendants, with a runner, a bowl of fruit and chairs or benches down each side, and the two leaves kept close by for the next big night. This listing is for one dining table.

This dining table is made for those generous, unhurried meals. At nearly eight feet long it seats a full household with the platters going around, and it stands on two upright posts, a strong, architectural base that suits a table of this scale.

At 39 inches wide there is space for serving dishes down the centre, and its 245 lbs keep it solid under a full spread. It ships in three boxes and needs assembly.

Set it in a long dining room or a farmhouse kitchen with a row of candles, a board of bread and cheese, and an open bottle of something red. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Fontevraud Long Pine Dining Table — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
At Fontevraud, the great royal monastery in the Loire Valley, the community took its meals together in a vaulted dining hall, at long tables where everyone sat side by side and the bread was passed from hand to hand. This long table is made for meals where the whole household eats at one board. Eight feet long and 42 inches wide, it seats a crowd down both sides, with room in the middle for the platters and the bread.

It is made of pine in the plain, sturdy form of the monastery table, a long top on a simple base with nothing fussy to come between the people around it. Pine has been the everyday timber of the long country table for centuries, and its warm, open grain suits a room of plaster walls and stone floors. It ships in one box and needs assembly.

Give it the length of a dining room or a big farmhouse kitchen, with benches or chairs down each side and the Sunday roast at its centre. This listing is for one dining table.

It runs eight feet from end to end, with room for a whole crowd, and its plain pine top asks for nothing more than good bread, a pot of stew and people to share it.

Benches or a mix of chairs along both sides suit it in a dining room or a farmhouse kitchen, a jug of wildflowers in the middle and the bread board passed from hand to hand. This listing is for one dining table.

Give it a large dining room or a long farmhouse kitchen, set with a linen runner, earthenware platters and jugs of flowers, and line both sides with benches or a mix of chairs. This listing is for one dining table.

input.title: BH | Premier Hove Ash and Linen Counter Stool
input.descriptionHtml:
The Regency squares of Brunswick Town in Hove were laid out in the 1820s for an elegant, sociable life, and that love of company has simply moved to the kitchen: someone cooking, someone opening a bottle, friends drawn up at the counter to keep them company. This counter stool is made for that spot. It brings a guest up to the right height to talk across the island, with a back to lean against and linen upholstery that stays comfortable through a long conversation.

The frame is ash, a strong, springy hardwood long favoured by chairmakers, shaped after a classic dining chair and raised to counter height. A 26-inch seat height suits a standard kitchen counter or island, and the 18-inch seat depth leaves room to sit back rather than perch on the edge. It arrives fully assembled.

Line two or three along a kitchen island or under a breakfast bar, where they hold a guest with a glass of wine while dinner is finished, or a child doing homework while the kettle boils. This listing is for one counter stool.

This stool is made for that moment and all the others like it. Its square top of canvas and leather straps is broad enough to perch on, put your feet up on or stack a pile of folded towels.

The frame is wood, and the top is made of canvas and leather straps fixed with brass tacks, so it has the look of well-kept sailing gear. The canvas varies naturally in tone from one stool to the next, and the leather darkens and softens as it is used. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it in a mudroom or by the back door for pulling off boots, at the foot of a bed, or beside a sofa as an extra seat or a footrest when friends drop in after a day on the water. This listing is for one stool.

This trunk bench keeps that habit of packing things away and adds a padded seat on top. Store blankets, spare pillows or the things you only need at the change of season inside, then close it and sit down to tie your shoes.

It is wood wrapped in leather, with foam padding beneath the top for a comfortable seat. At four feet long and 20 inches high, it sits at an easy height for perching and holds plenty, and the leather softens gently with use, the way a well-travelled trunk's does. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it at the end of a bed with a folded throw on top, or in a hall where shoes go on and coats come off, with extra scarves and gloves stored inside. This listing is for one trunk bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Mölle Reclaimed Pine Bench — In Sage
input.descriptionHtml:
Mölle, on the tip of the Kullaberg peninsula, has been a seaside resort since the late 1800s, and its old villas have halls where wet boots and sandy shoes come off after a walk along the cliffs. This bench is made for that moment at the door. It gives you a place to sit and pull your boots off, with a back to lean against while you do it, and enough length for two people to sit side by side.

It is made of reclaimed pine with a vintage finish rubbed on by hand, so the old wood keeps its grain and character. At 61 inches long it suits a hall, a mudroom or a landing without taking over the space. It arrives fully assembled.

Place it in the entrance hall with a row of hooks above for coats and a basket beside it for boots and dog leashes, or at the end of a kitchen table as extra seating. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Saffron Walden Tufted Leather Bench — In Caramel
input.descriptionHtml:
Supper in a timber-framed house in Saffron Walden is an easygoing affair: a long table, a pot in the middle, and a bench along one side where everyone shuffles up to make room for one more. This bench is made for that side of the table. It is more than six feet long, so there is always space to squeeze in, and its padded leather top is comfortable through a long meal and quick to wipe after it.

The leather seat is tufted, buttoned down at intervals so the padding holds its shape, and it sits on an oak frame in a whitewashed finish that lets the grain show through. With no back, it slides under the table when it is not in use, and it slides out again when the guests arrive. It arrives fully assembled.

Run it along one side of a farmhouse dining table with chairs opposite, or set it in a hall where boots come off and bags go down. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Notting Hill Leather Cube Ottoman
input.descriptionHtml:
In Notting Hill, Saturday belongs to the Portobello Road market, and the morning after is for staying in: the papers spread across the floor, a pot of coffee, feet up until dark. This leather cube is made for exactly that kind of day. It is low and square, a ready footrest in front of an armchair, and firm enough to serve as an extra seat when friends drop by to share the papers.

It is leather wrapped over a wood frame, with clean square edges and nothing fussy about it, and at 15 inches square and 16 high it slips easily beside a chair or under a console when not in use. At 23 lbs it moves from room to room without effort, wherever the papers go, and it arrives fully assembled.

Keep one by a reading chair with the papers piled on it, set a pair in front of a sofa, or use one at a dressing table. This listing is for one leather cube.

input.title: BH | Premier Amagansett Reclaimed Pine Bench — In Driftwood
input.descriptionHtml:
In an Amagansett beach house the back door is the busiest one: towels over the rail, sandy feet, and everyone stopping to kick off their shoes on the way in from the ocean. This bench is made for that doorway. Its long seat gives two people room to sit and pull on shoes side by side, and its back gives you something to lean against while you wait for the last one to get ready.

It is old reclaimed pine in a distressed painted finish, rubbed back by hand so the wood shows through at the edges the way a well-used piece does. The seat is 57 inches long and 17 inches high, a comfortable height for lacing up shoes or pulling up to the kitchen table. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it by the back door with a basket for flip-flops underneath and hooks for towels and hats above, or along one side of a kitchen table, where it seats the children at breakfast. This listing is for one bench.

In the French royal houses of the 1780s, Rambouillet among them, the day began with the toilette at the dressing table, where hair was dressed and jewelry chosen slowly and well. This stool is made for that ritual, wherever a day or an evening begins. Its tufted leather seat is soft enough to sit on through all of it, and its arched supports rise from a carved base with a grace that suits a bedroom.

The frame is solid walnut, a dense, fine-grained hardwood, carved at the base and shaped into arches beneath the seat, an old way of building that is strong as well as handsome. The seat is leather, tufted, or buttoned down in a pattern of soft hollows. At 22 inches high it suits most dressing tables and vanities. It arrives in one box and needs light assembly.

Tuck it under a dressing table with a mirror, a brush and a dish of earrings above, or set it at the foot of a bed for pulling on shoes. This listing is for one stool.

Set it in front of a sofa or a pair of club chairs in a living room or den, with a leather tray for drinks, a stack of the weekend papers and a pair of slippers kicked off beside it. This listing is for one ottoman.

input.title: BH | Premier Bayswater Square Leather Ottoman
input.descriptionHtml:
In the white stucco terraces of Bayswater, near Hyde Park, a London apartment's living room does every job at once: drinks before dinner, a card game after, and feet up for the late film. This ottoman is made to sit at the centre of all of it. At four feet square it is big enough for a tray of drinks on one side and a backgammon board on the other, and its leather top is just as good for putting your feet up or perching an extra guest.

It is covered in top grain cowhide joined with baseball stitching, a raised decorative seam like the one on a baseball, and edged with nailheads in an aged brass finish. It sits on a curved base, and at 18 inches high it matches the height of most sofa seats, so it works as a coffee table and as extra seating. It ships in one box and needs light assembly.

Set it in front of a sofa with a large tray for glasses, a bowl of nuts and a deck of cards, and pull it close when someone needs somewhere to rest their feet. This listing is for one ottoman.

input.descriptionHtml:
At the foot of a bed is where the day is put away: the quilt folded down at night, tomorrow's clothes laid out, a book left for the morning. This carved trunk is made for that spot, and its hand-cut surface carries something of Lorient, the Breton port built in the 1660s for the French East India Company and its trade with the East. The carving is done by hand, so it rewards a closer look every time you pass.

It is made of wood with hand-carved detail, more than five feet long and a low 18 inches tall, a strong, horizontal shape that anchors a wall or the end of a bed. At 105 lbs it is a substantial piece, and it arrives fully assembled.

Set it across the end of a bed with a folded quilt, a stack of books and a pair of slippers lined up beside it, or along an entry wall under a mirror, with a tray for keys and a basket beside it. This listing is for one trunk.

This footstool is made for exactly that. Its leather top sits at an easy height in front of an armchair, and it is just as useful as a spare seat when a friend pulls up close to talk.

The leather is stretched over a wooden frame, with a line of nailheads tracing the shape of its base, and it softens and warms the more it is used. At 18 inches square it is compact enough to tuck under a console table or carry from room to room as it is needed. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it in front of a reading chair in a living room or study, at the end of a bed for putting on shoes, or beside a sofa as an extra seat when everyone is home for the evening. This listing is for one ottoman.

input.title: BH | Premier Chesil Carved Acacia Bench — In Almond
input.descriptionHtml:
Chesil Beach runs for eighteen miles along the Dorset coast, a single bank of stones worn smooth by the sea and sorted by the waves from small to large. This bench brings that smooth, worn form into the hall, a place to sit and pull on boots before a walk along the shore. Its carved, rounded shape is as comfortable to perch on as it is good to run a hand along.

It is carved from solid acacia and made by hand in India, then finished to bring out the warmth of the grain. At more than six feet long it gives room to sit side by side, with an 18-inch seat height that suits most people, and at 45 lbs it is easy to move along the wall. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it along a wall in an entry with a row of hooks above for coats, or at the end of a long hall where it becomes a quiet place to sit and wait. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Santa Croce Leather Settee — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
In the Santa Croce quarter of Florence, where the leather school works in rooms of the old Franciscan friary, leather is made to be lived with: carried, sat on and handed down. This settee is made for a long conversation, sitting back with an elbow on the arm. Its tall back gives you something to lean into, its arms rise to an easy height for resting an elbow, and its leather only grows more handsome as it softens.

It is upholstered in split cowhide leather, the hard-wearing layer of the hide below the top grain, on a frame of oak. The seat sits 20 inches from the floor, an easy height to settle into and to rise from. Compact at under four feet wide, it fits places a sofa never could, and it arrives fully assembled.

Set it beside a fireplace in a study, or under a window in a bedroom, with a small table at one arm for a cup and a cushion against the other. This listing is for one settee.
